translations.web: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
translations.bsb: See that you do not neglect this matter. Why allow this threat to increase and the royal interests to suffer?
translations.kjv: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
translations.asv: And take heed that ye be not slack herein: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
